risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (274.6) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings 79 days away providing moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with bullish stochastic cross and RSI momentum in overbought territory suggests continuation potential in established uptrend.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), overbought technicals with stalling momentum, below-average volume support, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 79 days create asymmetric downside risk.
